headline: Mostly dry and mild through Friday; a weekend system is possible, but its track is uncertain.
summary: Dry weather dominates through Friday. Wednesday should be another mild, warmer-than-normal October day, with patchy fog possible early in sheltered spots that should lift by late morning. A weak system brushes the area Thursday, bringing more clouds, near-normal temperatures, and at most a few brief showers in the Olympics and north Cascades. Friday looks dry again. The weekend is less certain. A weak system may arrive Saturday night into Sunday, but computer models disagree on its path. Some bring a more direct system with somewhat more rain, while others keep it slower, farther north, or offshore, bringing less rain or pushing it to Sunday or Monday. Forecasters have good confidence in the next couple of days but are unsure about the weekend and early next week.
